flags.why: This is a dated term for a theatre, so uncommon alone does not adequately warn the learner ([dictionary](https://tienghoahangngay.com/tu-dien/tra-tu/h%C3%AD-tr%C6%B0%E1%BB%9Dng)).

This sense describes working diligently and continuously rather than simply being very busy ([Lạc Việt dictionary](https://tratu.coviet.vn/hoc-tieng-phap/tu-dien/lac-viet/all/hu%CC%80i%2Bhu%CC%A3i.html)).

Bận hùi hụi is an unnatural combination for the sense describing sustained, diligent work ([Lạc Việt dictionary](https://tratu.coviet.vn/hoc-tieng-phap/tu-dien/lac-viet/all/hu%CC%80i%2Bhu%CC%A3i.html)).
flags.fix: Cả nhà làm việc hùi hụi để chuẩn bị đám cưới. = The whole family worked away diligently to prepare for the wedding.

flags.why: The intensifier is used across regions, including Northern speech, so the Southern restriction is misleading ([linguistic study](https://vjol.info.vn/index.php/NNDS/article/download/16484/14766/)).
